title: Mobile top bar component + rollout
goal: Every one of the 14 design/screens/*.html mockups' mobile frame includes a MobileTopBar (title, optional back button) for page orientation once the desktop-only Sidebar disappears below lg (design/screens/03-today.html:82-87 and equivalents). No implemented route has one today, so mobile users get zero page-identification chrome anywhere in the app.
in_scope: New components/ui/mobile-top-bar.tsx: a 44-48px header with title text and an optional back button (Link to a fixed href, or router.back()), rendered only below the lg breakpoint -- parallel to the existing Sidebar/TabBar breakpoint split in app/(app)/layout.tsx:40,45.

Wire it into every app/(app)/**/page.tsx route (Today, Add, Add Manual, Review queue, Review Detail, Inventory, Inventory Detail, Plan, Shopping List, Insights, Catalog, Settings) using each screen's title from the corresponding design/screens/*.html mockup.

Add back={true} on Review Detail (app/(app)/review/[id]/page.tsx) and Inventory Detail (app/(app)/inventory/[id]/page.tsx) -- the two screens whose mockups show a back affordance (design/screens/07-review-detail.html:171, design/screens/09-inventory-detail.html:171).
out_of_scope: /gate and /onboarding -- explicitly excluded from nav chrome per the design spec's 'no nav chrome' note, already honored by the app/(app)/ route-group boundary.
Any change to the desktop Sidebar.
acceptance: A new components/ui MobileTopBar (title + optional back button) renders below the lg breakpoint on every app/(app) route with the screen's title; Review Detail and Inventory Detail show a working back button.
invariants: MobileTopBar must not render at >=lg viewport widths -- matches the existing Sidebar/TabBar breakpoint split.
Its title must not duplicate information already shown in a page's own CardTitle on the same screen -- it identifies the route, the Card identifies the content.
